resume.summary: Back-end developer with 5 years of experience, primarily working with .NET and C#. Experienced in developing, maintaining, and evolving software systems, including both new applications and legacy systems. Worked on Human Resources systems, contributing to everything from implementing new features to fixing bugs, improving, and maintaining existing applications. Also serves as an acting Tech Lead substitute, supporting technical decisions, tracking tasks, and guiding the team when needed. Additional experience with React, Java, and Python, as well as relational databases and software architecture practices.
resume.relevantProjectTitle: Sales Associate and Cashier Scheduling Management System
resume.relevantProjectDescription: Developed an application for creating, editing, and viewing work schedules for sales associates and cashiers. The system allows managers to assign employees to checkout lanes and departments, adjust shifts and breaks, track accrued hour and day balances to plan days off, and review scheduled absences such as vacations, leaves, and recurring days off. It also provides a view of employee distribution by department and allows staff to check their weekly schedules, helping them plan their work routines.
responsibilities: Develops APIs and applications using .NET and C#.

Maintains and evolves existing and legacy systems.

Acts as Tech Lead substitute, supporting the team with technical decisions and task tracking.
Works with React on front-end feature development and maintenance.
Uses Java and Python as required by project needs.
